Subset a features object to a set of cells

Source: R/features.R
subset_features.Rd

Keeps the rows of long and cells of the given cells and re-indexes the votes (whose cell is the row of cells) to the kept rows, so that update_allelic_features() and the tumour mode still give each cell its own votes; the 1 Mb window depth win keeps the kept cells' columns. Every other component is kept as it is.

Usage

subset_features(features, cells)

Arguments

features

scn_features (cell_features())

cells

cells to keep (others are ignored)

Value

the subset scn_features (the object itself when every cell is kept)
